description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter that implements logic for setting headers related to acknowledgements and response requirements in command objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages default header values, especially for implicit acknowledgements, and provides methods for header manipulation based on command properties.

classes.name: AbstractCommandAckRequestSetter
classes.description: An abstract class that sets default headers for command acknowledgements and response requirements, allowing subclasses to define specific binding behavior.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies header setting logic to a command if applicable.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the command is suitable for header modification.

methods.name: getMatchedClass
methods.description: Abstract method to return the class type of commands handled.

methods.name: isLiveChannelCommand
methods.description: Checks if the command was sent via the 'live' channel.

methods.name: isBindResponseRequiredToAddingRemovingImplicitLabel
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if response-required binding affects implicit acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: setDefaultDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets default headers for acknowledgement requests and response requirement based on current headers.

methods.name: implicitAcksRequested
methods.description: Determines whether implicit acknowledgement requests should be added or removed.

methods.name: explicitRequestedAcksFiltered
methods.description: Filters out negated acknowledgement labels from explicitly requested acknowledgements.

methods.name: responseRequiredSet
methods.description: Sets the response-required header if not already present.
